biggest_catch: $400 requires both $750 in direct deposits within 90 days AND using the debit card 5 times a month for three consecutive months — and the bonus itself is not paid until 90 days after the offer period ends.
catches: Open a TDECU Free Checking Account by 12/31/26; make a total of $750 or more in eligible direct deposits within 90 days; and activate and use the new TDECU contactless debit card five times a month for three consecutive months.
Eligible direct deposits are electronic ACH deposits (payroll, Social Security, pension, government benefits). Deposits made through a teller, ATM, or the TDECU Digital Banking app are ineligible.
Limit one account-opening bonus per account and one per member.
Official terms: The value of your gift will be reported on Form 1099-INT and deposited into your account 90 days after the offer has ended and meeting requirements.
Not available to individuals who were a primary account owner of a TDECU Free Checking account in the last 12 months; not available to current Free Checking customers.
Account must be in good standing and active at the time of bonus payment. Offer is subject to cancellation without notice.
Free refers to no monthly maintenance fees; subject to other account and penalty fees — see the fee schedule.
Membership is required (Texas/Houston-area credit union); the exact field of membership was not in the captured official terms — confirm eligibility on tdecu.org before opening.

steps: Read the official offer terms at https://www.tdecu.org/getchecking/ and confirm you meet TDECU's membership eligibility before opening (open by 2026-12-31).
Open a new TDECU Free Checking account (new customers only; not if you were a primary Free Checking owner in the last 12 months).
Within 90 days of opening, receive a total of $750 or more in eligible direct deposits (ACH: payroll, Social Security, pension, government benefits — teller/ATM/app deposits do not count).
Activate the new TDECU contactless debit card and use it five times a month for three consecutive months.
Keep the account open, active, and in good standing — the $400 bonus is deposited 90 days after the offer period ends. Expect it reported on Form 1099-INT.
timing: Bonus deposited into the account 90 days after the offer has ended (offer ends 12/31/26), once requirements are met; account must be in good standing and active at payment.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus $400. Per official terms: Bonus deposited into the account 90 days after the offer has ended (offer ends 12/31/26), once requirements are met; account must be in good standing and active at payment. Earliest realistic: ~4.0 months (3 monthly DD cycles + the payout window).
maximize: Fastest honest path. The offer requires consecutive months of direct deposits — payroll cycles are the hard floor and cannot be compressed. Fastest honest path: set up a real payroll direct deposit immediately (Zelle/bank transfers typically don't count) and keep it running uninterrupted; a missed month restarts the clock.
